content.short: Suilend is the leading lending protocol on Sui, developed by the Solend team to optimize capital efficiency.
content.description:
Suilend is the definitive decentralized money market built natively on the Sui blockchain, designed to provide a professional-grade borrowing and lending experience. Developed by the expert team behind Solana's Solend (Save), the platform focuses on institutional-grade security and maximum capital efficiency. Users can supply various digital assets to earn interest or borrow against them with sub-second finality, leveraging the high throughput and safety of Sui's Move programming language.

Deeply integrated with the Sui ecosystem, Suilend features innovative products like "SpringSui," a liquid staking standard that allows users to earn staking rewards while maintaining collateral liquidity. The protocol is powered by the $SEND token and follows a community-first approach, serving as a central hub for liquidity management and asset discovery. Through its focus on professional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, Suilend is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios within the Sui network.
content.meta: Suilend offers decentralized lending and borrowing on Sui with professional-grade security and high capital efficiency.
